requirement_summary.text_fragment: FODT root element is <office:document> with office:mimetype='application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.text'
FODT document body is contained in <office:body>/<office:text>
Paragraphs are <text:p> elements within <office:text>
Headings are <text:h> elements with text:outline-level attribute
Lists are <text:list> elements containing <text:list-item> children
Text spans are <text:span> elements with text:style-name attribute for inline styling
Hyperlinks are <text:a> elements with xlink:href attribute
Tables in text are <table:table> elements within <office:text>
Sections are <text:section> elements that can contain paragraphs, headings, lists, and nested sections
Notes (footnotes/endnotes) are <text:note> elements with text:note-class attribute
Automatic styles are in <office:automatic-styles> element within <office:document>
Bookmarks are <text:bookmark> or <text:bookmark-start>/<text:bookmark-end> pairs with text:name
Font declarations are in <office:font-face-decls> containing <style:font-face> elements
Text style properties are in <style:text-properties> with attributes for font, size, weight
Paragraph style properties are in <style:paragraph-properties> with alignment, margin, line-height
The <text:h> element's text:outline-level attribute is an integer from 1 to 10 with a default value of 1
The <text:list-item> element can contain <text:h>, <text:list>, <text:number>, <text:p>, and <text:soft-page-break> child elements
The <text:tracked-changes> element contains <text:changed-region> children and has the text:track-changes attribute
The <text:changed-region> element contains exactly one of <text:insertion>, <text:deletion>, or <text:format-change>
The <text:table-of-content> element represents a table of contents and contains <text:index-body> and <text:table-of-content-source>
